top_signals.title: Zelenskyy to meet with U.S. envoy as tensions with Trump mount
top_signals.summary: Ukraine's President Volodymyr Zelenskyy is set to meet with U.S. special envoys on Tuesday after President Donald Trump aimed fresh criticism at the wartime leader.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Policy paper: 11th UK-Singapore Financial Dialogue October 2026: Joint Statement
top_signals.summary: Joint statement between HM Treasury and the Monetary Authority of Singapore on the Eleventh Financial Dialogue, held Tuesday 20th October 2026.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Near miss: Indonesia probes crash of suspected Chinese rocket fragment
top_signals.summary: The debris was found on Monday morning by a plantation worker in Indonesian Borneo, after residents reported hearing a loud bang the previous evening.
